name: Tomoe Makina
source:
Makina Tomoe is an osananajimi of Shizuma and a very energetic one. She is very athletic and is the captain of quidditch some sort of magical lacrosse(?). While Makina is the pinnacle of fitness, she is awful at studying and would head over to her older twin sister’s room to ask for help. Some of Makina’s characteristics are that she loves to eat and has a problem waking up early.

[Edited from [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=374]m3rryweather's review[/url].]
